A named place in memory that stores a value is called a ____.

Explain what a variable is and give one example from a program.
questions.answer: A variable is a named storage location in memory that holds a value that can change (1). Example: score = 0 or name = 'Sam' (1).

questions.q: State the difference between print() and input() in Python.
questions.answer: print() displays something on the screen (output) (1); input() waits for the user to type something and stores it (1).

questions.q: A Scratch script says: when flag clicked, repeat 4 times { move 100 steps, turn 90 degrees }. Describe what the sprite does.
questions.answer: The sprite moves 100 steps and turns 90 degrees four times (1), so it draws/walks a square and ends where it started (1).
